product_metadata.title: Rox Football Ice Cube Tray for Football Fans & Game Day, Large
features: Madden never had it so good: giant ice cube tray creates 2 large 3.5" X 2.3" football shaped masterpieces that melt slowly, chills longer
The bigger it is, the longer it lasts: say goodbye to watered down, warm, or dainty drinks
Game day spirit, gone wild: football lovers rejoice
Don't get a flag on the play
Score a touchdown with the perfect gift for your football fan: better than scotch ice cubes
description: Giant game day football ice cube maker for people who get it You sip your drink. It's Luke warm, watery, and wimpy. Not what you'd hoped for. So you jump off the couch to grab more ice or a refills you think, I’ll just be gone a second...What could happen? And that's when you miss the biggest play of the game! Never miss a big play again with the must-have game day gear every football fan should own. Engineered to help you stay focused on the play It’s a proven fact; the bigger it is, the longer you'll last in front of the screen that is. And this giant ice cube tray makes 2 stunning 3.5" X 2.3" Football shaped conversation starters... Enough for you and a buddy, or to keep that double tall drink cold for the entire game. What's better? Unlike most ice cube sculpture makers this top ice maker won't explode in your freezer, yet still easily releases the ice when it's time. How? Simply fill to the line. Overflow holes insure appropriate water volume as the top lid pushes the liquid up to the top domes, so it freezes into that recognizable football shape friends will ask about every time. Plus this multi-purpose kitchen barware can keep your game day spirits up all year long. Preferred over scotch ice cubes, and far less expensive than a chill able whiskey glass, this multi-purpose barware can make giant jello shots, frozen margarita pops, wine cubes for wine slushies, and more.
